tools.name: list_protocols
tools.description: Every covered protocol: id, name, Snapshot spaces and watched contracts on Ethereum and Base. Free.

tools.name: quick_check
tools.description: Free: counts of active and recent governance proposals and of contract upgrades or admin changes for one protocol, without the details. About 20 calls a minute per client.

tools.name: protocol_changes
tools.description: Everything that changed in one protocol over a window: Snapshot proposals with live vote tallies, quorum and end time; proxy upgrades and admin changes with transactions; and the current implementation and admin of each watched contract. Costs $0.005 (x402, USDC).

tools.name: contract_check
tools.description: Live check of any contract on Ethereum or Base before you interact with it: is it an upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967, beacon, ZeppelinOS), its current implementation, and whether upgrades and owner() are controlled by a single key, a Safe multisig (m-of-n) or a timelock. tools.name: protocol_digest
tools.description: One call across every watched protocol: governance votes open now, proposals decided in the window with the winning choice, and every contract upgrade or admin change. Costs $0.02 (x402, USDC).
